subject.title: feat(cloud-workers): authenticated worker protocol with closed ingress and minted credentials

question: Does this dedicated loopback ingress, minted-credential lifecycle, and owner-epoch fencing establish the security boundary maintainers want later cloud-worker RPCs to inherit?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but accepting a new authenticated execution-host identity and durable credential contract is a security-architecture decision that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve this boundary
options.body: Accept the dedicated closed protocol after the docs map and exact-head refresh are complete, with full live integration proof required in the later worker-loop milestones.

options.title: Redesign before extension
options.body: Keep the milestone paused and narrow or replace the listener, identity, or credential contract before transcript and inference RPCs are added.

recommendation.title: Approve this boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the dedicated closed protocol after the docs map and exact-head refresh are complete, with full live integration proof required in the later worker-loop milestones.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the cloud-worker plan, all preceding merged milestones, and this security-boundary implementation.
